name: charts-recharts
description: Teaches the assistant to draw bar, line and pie charts in chat with the Recharts chart provider: finding the chart components with search_components, the data shape each one takes, what Recharts draws and what falls back to a table, and the generic chart.spec entry for several series. Know-how only: no code, no MCP server; the Recharts provider plugin (charts-recharts) draws the charts and switches this plugin on and off.

tovu.summary: Lets the assistant draw bar, line and pie charts in chat. Ask for a chart of your data.
